title: The Hidden Isosceles Triangle | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
Three side lengths are given, but you only need one. Vantee finds the hidden isosceles triangle with a bisector and a parallel line, shows a second way by building a rhombus, explains why each wrong answer is tempting, and gives you a lopsided triangle to try yourself.
